contract_gaps.report_image_path: The official GET /reports/images/:image route has no path parameter. A literal route is not useful, and an invented brace parameter would not prove against the pin.
contract_gaps.saml_metadata_media: The Swagger produces value is the malformed combined string application/xml;application/samlmetadata+xml. The binding requests and captures the specific standard application/samlmetadata+xml representation.
contract_gaps.prometheus_batch_bodies: Two batch conversion POST routes advertise JSON and YAML consumption but omit the body parameter even though their summaries require submitted rule groups. All four conversion writes require literal YAML body_raw.
contract_gaps.nested_request_int64: Twelve JSON mutations contain nested int64 values. They require literal body_raw JSON because the current exact-decimal request selector grammar is intentionally top-level only.
contract_gaps.datasource_proxy_route: Datasource proxy route placeholders are emitted as one path segment. Slash-bearing values are rejected by the URL safety layer, so callers must use a documented one-segment resource route.
contract_gaps.search_team_groups: The pinned schema describes a root array of pagination envelopes while the route takes page and perpage. The operation remains callable with manual page arguments but does not claim automatic completeness.
contract_gaps.browser_callbacks: Four SAML browser redirect/callback routes and one email-verification redirect are excluded because service-account REST credentials cannot supply their browser session state; several also omit required assertion or verification inputs.
contract_gaps.swagger_auth_metadata: Five operations inherit security metadata advertising both Basic and api_key, but their pinned operation prose explicitly requires Basic authentication. Those routes are assigned only to the separate Basic-auth server-admin pack.
contract_gaps.unpaged_collections: Collection-shaped reads without a proven continuation contract remain one bounded response and make no completeness claim.

source_decision.reason: Dashboard search rows expose stable UIDs, but dashboard read nests the document in an untyped Json field. Folders have stable UIDs and versions but no canonical task, note, or project state, and alert rules are not one of those entity kinds. Declaring a Source would invent either a field contract or an entity category.

candidates_rejected.reason: Read payload dashboard is untyped Json, so canonical title, body, state, and version fields cannot be proven.
Folder is a navigation container, not a task, note, or project, and it has no canonical state field.
An alerting rule is not a task, note, or project entity.

operations.reason: The pinned official Swagger path uses the framework-style literal segment :image and declares no path parameter. Emitting that literal would not expose a selectable image, while replacing it with a template would no longer prove against the pin. The operation remains excluded until Grafana publishes a buildable brace-parameter contract.
